captureMethod: CUA real input; normal user page; manual DOM/visual observation
metricScope: Composited screenshot includes HUD; not raw WebGL canvas. Statistics do not establish visual quality alone.

renderer.gpu: ANGLE (Apple, ANGLE Metal Renderer: Apple M4, Unspecified Version)

limitations: No named-state or seed hooks were invoked; state is an observed actual server game.
Frame times are from Apple M4 hardware on a local desktop, including the mobile viewport; not physical phone performance.
Representative pre-action view is not a full-field or effect-stress benchmark.
Budget excludes texture-byte memory, which was not measured.
